rules: Duplicates caused 5 of 20 rejects (25%) and subtree collisions (archive_subtree + alpha101_subtree) caused 8 of 20 (40%), the two biggest waste sources this round. $asset_turnover alone produced 2 duplicate submissions; check the batch for exact repeats before submitting, especially when iterating the same fundamental.

The stochastic/Williams-%R block, ($close - TS_MIN($low,W)) / (TS_MAX($high,W) - TS_MIN($low,W) + eps) and its TS_MEAN(high/low) variant, is fully saturated at W = 10, 21, 63. It alone caused 4 of 20 rejects this round (correlation 0.885 and 0.915, plus two archive_subtree hits sharing 15 nodes). Avoid this shape entirely, including nested inside a larger expression.

Normalizing a field by its own TS_STD is now saturated for both $close and $open: (TS_MAX($close,21) - $close)/TS_STD($close,21) and TS_DELTA($open,5) * TS_STD($open,63)/TS_STD($open,10) each collided with an archived member on 4 to 5 shared nodes. Treat this same-field self-vol-ratio chassis as closed across price fields.

CS_RANK(TS_RANK($close,10)) as a leading term collided with a seed Alpha101 formula (alpha101_subtree, 4 shared nodes) regardless of what it was multiplied against. This gate checks against the reference alpha library, not just prior GP output, so rank-of-rank($close) prefixes are blocked independent of archive state.

$earnings_per_share - CS_ZSCORE(TS_MEAN($dollar_volume,21)) is closed regardless of how the eps leg is wrapped: bare eps and TS_DELTA($earnings_per_share,63) both shared 4 nodes with an archived member. Vary the dollar_volume leg (window, transform, or field) rather than the eps leg to escape it.

All three $asset_turnover proposals this round died (2 duplicates, 1 archive_subtree hit), and all three paired it with a TS_MEAN($return,w) term (w = 5 or 21). Pair asset_turnover with a magnitude or vol leg instead of a return-mean leg.

Close/return momentum crossed with a fundamental failed cheap_screen in every form tried this round: rank-difference of close over 5 vs 42 days (|t| 0.47), close-delta over return-vol with matched short windows, 3 vs 10 (|t| 0.80), autocorrelation-weighted return sum (|t| 0.93), and return min+max over range (|t| 0.32).

The one delta/vol-normalized accept (fitness 1.195) paired a short delta lag (2d) with a much longer vol window (42d); the same shape with closer lags (delta 3d / std 10d) failed cheap_screen at 0.80. Favor a wide gap between the numerator lag and the denominator's vol window over matched short/short pairs.
